levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق
محمد ابن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: The Sadiq is written after عن in the chain, so he is a narrator; the Amir al-Mu'minin speaks in the story, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
Dhi'lib asks inside the story and is only in the scene, not a link; the poems and the author's remark are left out.
